introHtml: Custom 14 oz candy offers a generous portion size that stands out in gift baskets, welcome kits, or break rooms. Whether you choose a classic treat like the 12 oz Stemless Wine Tumbler w/Plastic Lining - Jelly Belly® Champagne Bubbles or another confection, this size delivers value and visibility for your brand.
